tools.name: Get account trigger statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve statistics about account-level triggers and automations. Use when you need to monitor trigger execution metrics including success rates, failure counts, and total execution numbers.

tools.name: Activate users
tools.description: Tool to activate or reactivate users in a Monday.com account. Use when you need to enable user accounts that were previously deactivated. Cannot be used to activate your own account. Requires account management permissions.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of user IDs to activate. Maximum of 200 user IDs per request.

tools.name: Add subscribers to board
tools.description: Tool to add users as subscribers to a Monday.com board. Use when granting subscriber or owner access to specific users on a board. Note: This mutation is deprecated - consider using add_users_to_board instead.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: Role for the added users on the board. Possible values: 'owner' or 'subscriber'. Defaults to 'subscriber'.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board's unique identifier.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: Array of user unique identifiers to add as subscribers to the board.

tools.name: Add subscribers to object
tools.description: Tool to add subscribers or owners to a monday.com object. Use when you need to grant users notification access or ownership permissions to a specific object.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the object to add subscribers to.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: The role to assign to users. Defaults to 'subscriber' if not specified. 'owner' grants full control permissions, 'subscriber' grants notification access only.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: Array of user identifiers to add as subscribers.

tools.name: Add teams to board
tools.description: Tool to add teams to a Monday.com board with specified permission levels. Use when you need to associate teams with a board as owners or subscribers.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: Role for the added teams on the board. Possible values: 'owner' or 'subscriber'. If not specified, teams will be added as subscribers.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of an existing Monday.com board.

inputs.name: team_ids
inputs.about: List of unique identifiers for existing Monday.com teams. Pass -1 to subscribe all account members to the board.

tools.name: Add users to board
tools.description: Adds users to a Monday.com board with a specified role.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: Role for the added users on the board.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of an existing Monday.com board.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of unique identifiers for existing Monday.com users.

tools.name: Add users to team
tools.description: Adds users to a Monday.com team. Inspect the returned response for successful and failed users and GraphQL errors; these errors do not necessarily cause the tool call to fail.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of an existing Monday.com team.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of unique identifiers for existing Monday.com users.

tools.name: Add users to workspace
tools.description: Adds existing users to a workspace. The returned success flag can be true even when no added users are returned; inspect the added users list.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: The role to assign to the users in the workspace. 'owner' grants full control over the workspace. 'subscriber' grants access to view and collaborate on boards within the workspace.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of numeric user IDs to add to the workspace. You can get user IDs from the list_users action or from board subscribers.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric ID of the workspace to add users to. You can get workspace IDs from the get_workspaces action or from board details.

tools.name: Aggregate board data
tools.description: Aggregate data from a Monday.com board using functions such as COUNT, SUM, MEAN, MIN, and MAX, with optional filtering and grouping.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Aggregation query configuration including data source, selections, grouping, and filters.

tools.name: Get app subscription
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current app subscription data for the account. Use when you need to check subscription status, billing period, trial status, or pricing information. Must be called within app context using account authentication token.

tools.name: Archive board
tools.description: Archives a specified, existing, and unarchived board in Monday.com; archived boards can typically be restored later.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the board to be archived; it must exist and not already be archived.

tools.name: Archive item
tools.description: Archives an existing Monday.com item, moving it from active board views to the archive where it can be potentially restored.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Monday.com item to archive.

tools.name: Archive object
tools.description: Archives a Monday.com object by changing its state to archived rather than permanently deleting it. Use when you need to remove objects from active use while preserving the ability to restore them later.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Monday.com object to archive. Can be an ID for various object types like boards, items, or workspaces.

tools.name: Archive workspace
tools.description: Delete a Monday.com workspace by its ID, returning its ID and name.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workspace to archive.

tools.name: Get audit logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed security-related activity records for a Monday.com account. Use when you need to audit user actions, security events, or account activity. Requires Enterprise plan and account admin permissions with manage_account_security scope.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (starts at 1).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of log entries to return per page.

inputs.name: events
inputs.about: Array of specific event types to retrieve (e.g., 'login', 'logout').

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: Filter audit logs for a specific user by their ID.

inputs.name: end_time
inputs.about: Filter logs up to this date/time (ISO8601 format).

inputs.name: ip_address
inputs.about: Filter logs by specific IP address.

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: Filter logs from this date/time onwards (ISO8601 format).

tools.name: Get document blocks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve document block data from workdocs via the API. Returns block metadata including type, content, position, and creation info. Use when you need to fetch content blocks from Monday.com documents.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of blocks to return per document. Defaults to 25.

inputs.name: doc_ids
inputs.about: List of document IDs to retrieve blocks from. At least one doc ID is required.

tools.name: Get boards
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for one or multiple monday.com boards, including owners and workspace details, with filters for state, board kind, hierarchy type, and workspace.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: List of specific board IDs to retrieve. Provide to filter by board IDs.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination; starts at 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of boards to return. Default is 25.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: Filter boards by state. Valid values: 'active', 'archived', 'deleted', 'all'. Default is 'active'.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Sort boards by 'created_at' or 'used_at' in descending order.

inputs.name: board_kind
inputs.about: Filter boards by type. Valid values: 'private', 'public', 'share'.

inputs.name: workspace_ids
inputs.about: List of workspace IDs to filter boards by workspace.

inputs.name: hierarchy_type
inputs.about: Filter boards by hierarchy type. Can include 'classic', 'multi_level', or both.

tools.name: Change simple column value
tools.description: Changes a monday.com item's column value using a simple string, suitable for Text, Status, or Dropdown columns. For Status or Dropdown columns, it can create missing labels; label creation is enabled by default.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: New string value. For Status columns: use either a label name (e.g., 'Done', 'Working on it') or an index number as string (e.g., '1'). For Dropdown columns: use the label name. For Text columns: use plain text.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item for which the column value will be updated.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board where the item and column are located.

inputs.name: column_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the column to change; typically a Text, Status, or Dropdown column.

inputs.name: create_labels_if_missing
inputs.about: For Status/Dropdown columns: when true (default), the label will be matched or created if it doesn't exist. Set to false only when using index values or when you want strict label matching.

tools.name: Get board columns
tools.description: Retrieves column metadata from monday.com boards, including type, title, settings, and archived status, with optional filters by column ID and type.

inputs.name: board_ids
inputs.about: Array of board IDs to retrieve columns from. Must provide at least one board ID.

inputs.name: column_ids
inputs.about: Optional array of specific column IDs to filter. Column IDs are strings (1-20 characters, lowercase letters and underscores only).

inputs.name: column_types
inputs.about: Optional array of column types to filter. Available types: auto_number, button, checkbox, color_picker, board_relation, country, creation_log, date, dependency, dropdown, email, file, formula, hour, item_id, last_updated, link, location, long_text, mirror, doc, name, numbers, people, phone, progress

tools.name: Get connection board IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve board IDs associated with connection columns. Use when you need to discover which boards can be linked through connection columns. Queries boards and filters for connection columns (board_relation type) to extract the configured board IDs from their settings.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of boards to retrieve. Defaults to 25 if not specified.

inputs.name: board_ids
inputs.about: List of specific board IDs to query. If not provided, queries all accessible boards up to the limit.

tools.name: Get connections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve connection data for integrations with external services. Use when you need to inspect or manage integrations like Gmail, Slack, or other external service connections. Returns a list of connections with details about authentication, state, and associated accounts.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page index for offset-based pagination (starts at 1). Use this for traditional page-by-page navigation.

inputs.name: order
inputs.about: Ordering of returned connections. Use field name for ascending (e.g., 'createdAt') or prefix with '-' for descending (e.g., '-createdAt').

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Records per page for offset-based pagination. Determines how many connections are returned per page.

inputs.name: pagination
inputs.about: Cursor-based pagination configuration.

inputs.name: connection_state
inputs.about: Filter by connection state (e.g., 'active', 'inactive'). Only connections matching this state will be returned.

inputs.name: with_automations
inputs.about: Include connections with automations attached. Set to true to only return connections that have automations.

inputs.name: with_partial_scopes
inputs.about: Include connections created with partial scopes. When true, connections with limited permissions are included.

inputs.name: with_state_validation
inputs.about: Validate connection state before returning. When true, the API validates each connection's current state.

tools.name: Connect project to portfolio
tools.description: Links an existing project board to a portfolio board for centralized management. Requires boards:write scope and Enterprise plan.

inputs.name: project_board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the project board to connect to the portfolio.

inputs.name: portfolio_board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the portfolio board to which the project will be linked.

tools.name: Convert board to project
tools.description: Converts a regular Monday.com board into a project board with advanced project management features. Use when upgrading a board to enable project-specific capabilities like timeline views, project status tracking, and owner assignments.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board to convert to a project.

inputs.name: column_mappings
inputs.about: Mapping configuration specifying which existing columns should be used for project-specific fields (status, timeline, owner).

tools.name: Create a Monday board
tools.description: Creates a Monday.com board; `template_id` if used must be accessible, and `folder_id` must be in `workspace_id` if both are provided.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: ID of the folder for the board. If `workspace_id` is absent, the board uses this folder's containing workspace. If `workspace_id` is present, this folder must be within the specified workspace.

inputs.name: board_kind
inputs.about: The kind of board to create, determining its visibility and access.

inputs.name: board_name
inputs.about: The name for the new board.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description for the new board.

inputs.name: template_id
inputs.about: ID of an accessible template to use for the new board.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the workspace for the board. Use MONDAY_GET_WORKSPACES action to retrieve valid workspace IDs. This field is optional - if omitted, the board is created in the default workspace. If `folder_id` is given, this workspace must contain that folder.

inputs.name: board_owner_ids
inputs.about: User IDs to be assigned as owners of the board.

inputs.name: board_subscriber_ids
inputs.about: User IDs to be subscribed to the board.

inputs.name: board_subscriber_teams_ids
inputs.about: Team IDs to be subscribed to the board.

tools.name: Create column
tools.description: Creates a new column with a specified type and title on a monday.com board.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title for the new column.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board for the new column. Note: Subitems boards are not supported; use create_subitem mutation instead.

inputs.name: defaults
inputs.about: JSON string with default values or settings, often for 'status' or 'dropdown' types to define labels. Example: '''{"labels": ["To Do", "In Progress", "Done"]}'''

inputs.name: column_type
inputs.about: Type of the column. Must be a valid GraphQL enum token in snake_case format (e.g., 'long_text', not 'text_long' or 'long-text'). Supported types include: status, text, long_text, numbers, date, dropdown, people, timeline, link, email, phone, rating, checkbox, country, file, hour, week, item_id, loca

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description for the new column.

inputs.name: after_column_id
inputs.about: ID of an existing column after which the new column will be inserted.

tools.name: Create custom activity
tools.description: Tool to create a custom activity in the Monday.com Emails & Activities app. Use when you need to define a new activity type with specific color and icon for tracking interactions.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The custom activity's name. Must be non-empty.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The custom activity's color. Must be one of the predefined color values.

inputs.name: icon_id
inputs.about: The custom activity's icon. Must be one of the predefined icon values.

tools.name: Create a Monday dashboard
tools.description: Tool to create a Monday.com dashboard with associated boards. Use when you need to establish a new dashboard in a workspace with specific board visibility settings.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: The dashboard's visibility. Valid values: PRIVATE (default) or PUBLIC.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The dashboard's name. Maximum 255 characters.

inputs.name: board_ids
inputs.about: The unique identifier(s) of the board(s) to associate with the dashboard. Must provide at least one valid board ID.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workspace to create the dashboard in. Use -1 for the main workspace.

inputs.name: board_folder_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the folder to create the dashboard in.

tools.name: Create doc
tools.description: Tool to create a new doc in Monday.com. Use when you need to add a doc to a workspace or into a doc column on an item.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: Access level of the new doc in workspace. Choose one of 'private', 'public', or 'share'.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Title of the new doc. Required with workspace_id and kind for workspace location.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: ID of the item containing the doc column. Required with column_id for board location.

inputs.name: column_id
inputs.about: ID of the monday doc column on the item (e.g., 'monday_doc'). Required with item_id for board location.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: ID of the workspace where the doc will be created. Required with name and kind for workspace location.

tools.name: Create a folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new folder in a Monday.com workspace to organize boards. Use when you need to structure boards within a workspace by grouping them into folders.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The folder's name.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The folder's color.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workspace to create the new folder in.

inputs.name: parent_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the folder you want to nest the new one under. Use this to create subfolder hierarchies.

tools.name: Create group
tools.description: Creates a new group with the given `group_name` on an existing Monday.com board, identified by its `board_id`.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Monday.com board where the new group will be created.

inputs.name: group_name
inputs.about: The desired name for the new group to be created on the board.

tools.name: Create item
tools.description: Creates a new item on a Monday.com board, optionally assigning it to a group and setting column values.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board's unique identifier. Note: Subitems boards are not supported for this action; use create_subitem mutation instead.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Optional group ID where the item will be created.

inputs.name: item_name
inputs.about: Name of the new item. Maximum length is 256 characters.

inputs.name: column_values
inputs.about: Column values for the new item. Accepts either a JSON string or an object/dict. Keys must be valid column IDs and values must match the column type. For date columns, use nested structure: {"date": {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}}. For people columns, use array of person IDs: {"person": {"personsAndTeams": [

tools.name: Create Item From Natural Language
tools.description: Creates a new item on a Monday.com board from a natural language description. Fetches the board's column schema at runtime, uses an LLM to generate the column values and extract the item name, and creates the item.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The Monday.com board ID where the item will be created.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Optional group ID where the item will be created within the board.

inputs.name: nl_query
inputs.about: Natural language description of the item to create. Must include an item name. Example: 'Create item: Fix login bug, status Working on it, priority High, due date 2025-03-15'.

tools.name: Create notification
tools.description: Tool to send a notification to a user. Use when you need to alert a user about a board, item, or update. Call after obtaining the user and target IDs.

inputs.name: text
inputs.about: The notification text to display.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The recipient user's unique identifier (ID).

inputs.name: target_id
inputs.about: The target's unique identifier (ID). If target_type is Post, use an update or reply ID; if Project, use an item or board ID.

inputs.name: target_type
inputs.about: The notification target type: 'Post' for updates/replies or 'Project' for items/boards.

tools.name: Create object
tools.description: Execute a custom Monday.com GraphQL mutation, with optional variables. It can create objects such as workspaces, boards, items, columns, docs, updates, and webhooks, and can also modify or delete data.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: GraphQL mutation query to create an object. Must start with 'mutation'. For read queries, use the appropriate query tool instead. Examples: 'mutation { create_workspace(name: "My Workspace", kind: open) { id name } }' or 'mutation { create_item(board_id: 123, item_name: "Task") { id name } }'

inputs.name: variables
inputs.about: Optional GraphQL variables object to pass with the query. Use this to parameterize your mutation instead of hardcoding values in the query string.

tools.name: Create tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new tag or return an existing tag. Use when you need to label items with color-coded tags on a public or private board.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Optional board ID for a private tag; omit for a public tag.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: Name of the tag to create; must be non-empty.

tools.name: Create timeline item
tools.description: Tool to create a new timeline item in the Emails & Activities app on a Monday.com item. Use when you need to establish a timeline event or activity on an item. Note: Timeline items created via this action won't trigger automations that run when a new E&A timeline item is created.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: URL to add.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.about: Phone number to add. This input isn't verified as a phone number.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The new timeline item's title.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The new timeline item's content.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The ID of the item to create the new timeline item on. Must be a valid item identifier.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.about: The new timeline item's summary. Maximum 255 characters.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: Location data to add. This input isn't verified as a location.

inputs.name: timestamp
inputs.about: The new timeline item's creation time. Must be in ISO8601 format (e.g., 2024-12-10T10:00:00Z).

inputs.name: time_range
inputs.about: Time range for a timeline item.

inputs.name: custom_activity_id
inputs.about: The ID of the new timeline item's custom activity. Required identifier.

tools.name: Create update
tools.description: Tool to create a new update for an item or reply to an existing update. Use after determining the target item or update to comment on.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: The update's text content.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: ID of the item to post the update on.

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.about: ID of the parent update to reply under.

inputs.name: use_app_info
inputs.about: If true, attribute the update to the app rather than the current user (API version 2025-10+).

inputs.name: mentions_list
inputs.about: List of entities to mention in the update.

inputs.name: original_creation_date
inputs.about: Original creation date in DD-MM-YYYY format (API version 2025-10+).

tools.name: Invite and create a Monday user
tools.description: Tool to invite and create a new user. Use when you need to programmatically add new users to your Monday account.

inputs.name: emails
inputs.about: List of email addresses to invite and create.

inputs.name: product
inputs.about: Product to invite the user to; allowed values: 'crm', 'dev', 'forms', 'knowledge', 'service', 'whiteboard', 'workflows', 'work_management'.

inputs.name: user_role
inputs.about: Role to assign to the invited user; allowed values: 'ADMIN', 'GUEST', 'MEMBER', 'VIEW_ONLY'.

tools.name: Create a Monday workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a Monday.com workspace. Use when you need to programmatically add a workspace after planning your project structure.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: The visibility kind of the workspace; allowed values: 'open' or 'closed'.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new workspace.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Optional description for the new workspace.

inputs.name: account_product_id
inputs.about: Optional account product ID under which to create the workspace (API v2025-07+).

tools.name: Get custom activity
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom activity data from the Emails & Activities app. Use when you need to list available custom activities with their metadata. Returns up to 50 activities per query.

tools.name: Deactivate users
tools.description: Deactivates up to 200 users per request from a monday.com account; only admins can do so, and users cannot deactivate themselves. Deactivating a user also deactivates their integrations and automations.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: Array of user identifiers to deactivate. Maximum 200 users per request. Note: Cannot deactivate yourself, and only admins can execute this action.

tools.name: Delete asset
tools.description: Remove uploaded files by deleting an enclosing update or clearing all files from an item's File column; the required asset ID does not select which file is removed. Confirm with the user before invoking.

inputs.name: target
inputs.about: Deletion strategy: 'update' to delete the update, or 'column' to clear a File column

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Item ID whose File column should be cleared (used when target is 'column').

inputs.name: asset_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the asset related to the removal operation.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Board ID of the item (used when target is 'column').

inputs.name: column_id
inputs.about: File column ID to clear (used when target is 'column'). For example: 'files'.

inputs.name: update_id
inputs.about: ID of the update that contains the attachment to remove (used when target is 'update').

tools.name: Delete board
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a board from your Monday.com account. Use when you need to remove a board permanently after verifying its ID. This action cannot be undone.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board to be deleted.

tools.name: Delete column
tools.description: Deletes a specified column from a Monday.com board; this action is destructive and cannot be undone via the API.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board from which the column will be deleted.

inputs.name: column_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the column to be deleted from the specified board.

tools.name: Delete Custom Activity
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom activity from the Emails & Activities app. Use when you need to remove a custom activity by its unique identifier.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The custom activity's unique identifier.

tools.name: Delete doc
tools.description: Deletes a Monday.com doc by its ID, removing a document that is no longer needed. Returns the document ID and a success indicator.

inputs.name: doc_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Monday.com doc to delete.

tools.name: Delete folder
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a folder and all its contents from a Monday.com workspace. Use when you need to remove a folder along with all nested subfolders and boards. This action is irreversible.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the folder to be deleted. This will permanently remove the folder and all its nested contents including subfolders and boards.

tools.name: Delete group
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing group (and its items) from an existing board in Monday.com.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the group.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the group to delete.

tools.name: Delete item
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing Monday.com item; this action is irreversible via the API.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Monday.com item to be deleted.

tools.name: Delete object
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Monday.com object with a 30-day recovery grace period. Use when you need to remove any object type from Monday.com by its unique identifier.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Monday.com object to delete. Can be an ID for various object types like boards, items, or workspaces.

tools.name: Delete subscribers from board
tools.description: Tool to remove subscribers from a Monday.com board. Use when revoking subscriber access for specific users on a board.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board's unique identifier.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: Array of user unique identifiers to remove as subscribers.

tools.name: Delete tag
tools.description: Tool to remove a tag from an item in Monday.com. Important: Monday.com's GraphQL API does not provide a mutation to delete a tag from the account. Tags are account-level entities shared across boards. This action can remove a tag from a specific item by updating its tags column to exclude the given tag_id. To do so, provide item_id and board_id.

inputs.name: tag_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the tag to remove.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The item ID to remove the tag from. If provided, the tag will be removed from this item's tags column. If omitted, the action will report that account-level tag deletion is not supported.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board ID where the item lives. Required when item_id is provided.

tools.name: Delete team
tools.description: Delete an existing Monday.com team by ID. Inspect the raw response for GraphQL errors before treating the deletion as successful.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the team to be deleted.

tools.name: Delete teams from board
tools.description: Remove teams from a Monday.com board to revoke their board access. Inspect the raw response for GraphQL errors before treating the removal as successful.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board from which teams will be removed.

inputs.name: team_ids
inputs.about: List of unique identifiers for the teams to remove from the board. Multiple teams can be removed in a single operation.

tools.name: Delete teams from workspace
tools.description: Tool to remove teams from a workspace. Use when revoking workspace access for specific teams.

inputs.name: team_ids
inputs.about: The unique identifiers of the teams to remove from the workspace.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The workspace's unique identifier from which teams will be removed.

tools.name: Delete timeline item
tools.description: Tool to delete a timeline item from the Emails & Activities app. Use when you need to remove an existing timeline event or activity from a Monday.com item. This action is irreversible.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the timeline item to delete. Must be a valid UUID string.

tools.name: Delete update
tools.description: Tool to delete an update by its ID. Use when an update is no longer relevant. Use after confirming deletion is irreversible.

inputs.name: update_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the update to be deleted.

tools.name: Delete workspace
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a workspace by its ID. Use when a workspace is no longer needed. Use after confirming deletion is irreversible.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workspace to permanently delete.

tools.name: Retrieve Monday docs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Monday.com document data via the API. Use when you need to fetch documents with filtering by IDs, object IDs, workspace IDs, or with pagination support.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: List of document IDs to retrieve. These are the internal IDs shown in the top-left corner when developer mode is enabled.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1. Use in combination with 'limit' to retrieve large result sets.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of documents to retrieve per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Field to order results by. 'created_at' sorts by creation time, 'used_at' sorts by last access time. Newest first by default. Not applied when 'ids' parameter is used.

inputs.name: object_ids
inputs.about: List of object IDs (board or item IDs) associated with the documents. These are the IDs that appear in URLs and doc column values.

inputs.name: workspace_ids
inputs.about: List of workspace IDs to filter documents. Only documents within these workspaces will be returned.

tools.name: Duplicate board
tools.description: Tool to duplicate a Monday.com board with its structure and optionally items and updates. Use when you need to create a copy of an existing board. Duplication is asynchronous and may take time to complete for large boards.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board to duplicate. This board must exist.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: Destination folder ID within workspace. Required when moving to another workspace.

inputs.name: board_name
inputs.about: Name for the new board. If omitted, a name will be auto-generated.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Destination workspace ID. If omitted, the board will be duplicated to the original workspace.

inputs.name: duplicate_type
inputs.about: Specifies what to include in the duplicate: structure only, structure and items, or structure, items, and updates.

inputs.name: keep_subscribers
inputs.about: Whether to copy subscribers from the original board. Defaults to false.

tools.name: Duplicate item
tools.description: Duplicates an item on a Monday.com board, optionally including its updates.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item to be duplicated. This item must exist on the specified `board_id`.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board containing the item to be duplicated. This board must exist.

inputs.name: with_updates
inputs.about: If true, item updates (e.g., comments, replies) are duplicated with the item; if false, the new item is created without any updates.

tools.name: Edit update
tools.description: Tool to modify the text content of an existing update on an item. Use when you need to correct or change a previously posted update.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The update's unique identifier.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: The update's new text content.

tools.name: Get account info
tools.description: Retrieve account metadata and settings for the authenticated Monday.com account. Use this action to inspect account configuration such as: - Account name, slug, and tier - Active member count - Calendar preferences (first day of week, timeline weekends) - Active products and billing plan details Requires the 'account:read' OAuth scope.

tools.name: Get board activity logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve activity logs from a specific Monday.com board. Use when you need to track changes, user actions, or board history for auditing or analytics purposes.

inputs.name: to
inputs.about: End timestamp for filtering activity logs (ISO8601 DateTime format).

inputs.name: from
inputs.about: Start timestamp for filtering activity logs (ISO8601 DateTime format).

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (starts at 1).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of activity logs to return. Default is 25.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board to fetch activity logs from. Required.

inputs.name: item_ids
inputs.about: Filter events by specific item IDs.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: Filter events by specific user IDs.

inputs.name: group_ids
inputs.about: Filter events by specific group IDs.

inputs.name: column_ids
inputs.about: Filter events by specific column IDs.

tools.name: Get API version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the Monday.com API version in use. Use when you need to check which API version is currently active for debugging or compatibility purposes.

tools.name: Get assets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve file/asset metadata from monday.com by asset IDs. Returns file information including URL, name, size, extension, and thumbnails for images. Asset IDs originate from updates, update replies, or file-type columns.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: Array of asset IDs to retrieve. Must contain at least one ID. Asset IDs from file-type column values may be embedded in nested JSON strings and must be parsed before use.

tools.name: Get board views
tools.description: Tool to retrieve board view data via GraphQL API. Returns array of board view metadata including type, settings, filters, and access levels. Must be nested within a boards query.

inputs.name: board_ids
inputs.about: List of board IDs to retrieve views from. Must contain at least one board ID.

inputs.name: view_type
inputs.about: Optional filter to retrieve specific view type. Valid types: 'TABLE', 'FORM', 'DASHBOARD', 'APP'. If not specified, all views are returned.

tools.name: Get favorites
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all favorited items for the authenticated user. Use when you need to query items that have been marked as favorites.

tools.name: Get folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve folder data from workspaces with filtering and pagination options. Use when you need to list folders from specific workspaces or filter by folder IDs.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: Specific folder identifiers to retrieve. If not provided, all folders will be returned.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination, starts at 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of folders to return. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

inputs.name: workspace_ids
inputs.about: Workspace identifiers to filter folders. Pass [None] to get folders from the Main Workspace.

tools.name: Get form details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve form metadata via the API using the form's unique token from the URL. Returns form configuration, questions, and settings.

inputs.name: form_token
inputs.about: The form's unique string token, located in the form's URL after '/forms/' and before the '?' parameter. Use this to identify and retrieve the specific form.

tools.name: Get items by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific items by their IDs from Monday.com, returning metadata including name, timestamps, state, board, and group information. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about specific items.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: Array of item IDs to retrieve. Maximum of 100 IDs at one time.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of items to return. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

inputs.name: newest_first
inputs.about: When true, orders the results with recently created items first.

inputs.name: exclude_nonactive
inputs.about: When true, filters out inactive, deleted, or orphaned items from the results.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Tool to fetch the current authenticated user's profile and permissions. Use when you need to retrieve user metadata before performing other operations.

inputs.name: api_version
inputs.about: Optional Monday API version header (e.g., '2025-04'). Overrides default if provided.

tools.name: Execute GraphQL and get mutation complexity
tools.description: Execute a caller-provided Monday.com GraphQL document and return its complexity data. The supplied document runs in full and may perform destructive mutations.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: GraphQL document to execute against Monday.com. The document must request the top-level complexity field. Warning: the entire document is executed; mutations can create, modify, or delete Monday.com data.

tools.name: Get query complexity
tools.description: Retrieve Monday.com API complexity budget metrics and the cost of this complexity query, including the remaining budget before and after execution and the reset time.

tools.name: Get tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tags from the account. Use when you need to list all tags or filter by specific IDs.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: Optional list of tag IDs to filter; only tags matching these IDs will be returned.

tools.name: Get teams
tools.description: Tool to retrieve teams from Monday.com. Use when you need an overview of teams in your account.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: Optional list of team IDs to filter by. If omitted, all teams are returned.

tools.name: Get update replies
tools.description: Retrieves updates and their replies for a specific Monday.com item. Use this to fetch conversation threads and discussions attached to an item, including all replies to each update.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination, starts at 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of updates to return per page. Maximum 100, default 25.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item to fetch updates and replies for.

tools.name: Get item updates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve updates for a specific item. Use when you need to fetch the conversation history tied to an item.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (starts at 1).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of updates to return per page (max 100, default 25).

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item to fetch updates for.

tools.name: Get API versions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data about available API versions. Use when you need to check which API versions are supported by Monday.com.

tools.name: Get view schema by type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve type-specific board view configuration schemas via GraphQL API. Use when you need to understand the structure and available settings for creating or updating board views of a specific type.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Specifies which view type's schema to retrieve. Determines the structure of configuration settings returned.

inputs.name: mutation_type
inputs.about: Indicates whether the schema is for CREATE or UPDATE operations. Different mutation types may expose different configuration options.

tools.name: Get webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve webhooks for a board. Use when you need to list all webhooks on a board.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board to fetch webhooks for.

inputs.name: app_webhooks_only
inputs.about: Return only webhooks created by the calling app.

tools.name: Get workspaces
tools.description: Tool to retrieve workspaces. Use when you need to list workspaces with optional filtering, pagination, or ordering after authentication.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: List of specific workspace IDs to return. Provide to filter by workspace IDs.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: Filter by workspace kind. Valid values: 'open' or 'closed'.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination page number; starts at 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of workspaces to return. Default is 25.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: Filter by workspace state. Valid values: 'active', 'all', 'archived', 'deleted'.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Field to order by. Currently only 'created_at' is supported.

tools.name: Import doc from HTML
tools.description: Tool to import HTML content into a new Monday.com doc, converting it to doc blocks. Use when you need to create a doc from HTML content.

inputs.name: html
inputs.about: The HTML content to convert into a new doc. Supports style/format text, emoji, quote, table, list, code, divider, and title/header text.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: Document access level - private, public, or share. If omitted, defaults to workspace settings.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The new document's title. If omitted, the title will be inferred from the provided HTML content.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the folder to create the doc in. If omitted, the document will be created at the root level of the workspace.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workspace to create the doc in.

tools.name: Get items page
tools.description: Retrieve a page of items from a Monday.com board or group, with optional server-side filtering and sorting. Column values can be included as ID, text, and raw value; use the returned cursor to fetch subsequent pages.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of items to return per page. Default is 25, maximum is 500 per Monday.com API limits.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Opaque pagination cursor from previous response. When provided, retrieves the next page using next_items_page query. Cursors are cached for 60 minutes. If provided, board_id and query_params are ignored.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board's unique identifier. Required for initial fetch (when cursor is not provided). Ignored if cursor is provided.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Optional group ID to filter items within a specific group. Only used for initial fetch (when cursor is not provided). If provided, queries items within the group instead of the entire board.

inputs.name: query_params
inputs.about: Query parameters for filtering and sorting items.

inputs.name: include_column_values
inputs.about: Whether to include column_values in the response. When false, only returns id and name for each item.

tools.name: Like update
tools.description: Tool to like an update on an item. Use when you want to express approval or acknowledgment of an update.

inputs.name: update_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the update to like.

tools.name: List board items
tools.description: Lists a page of items from a specified monday.com board, returning their IDs, names, states, and a cursor. The tool is deprecated and may omit items on larger boards.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Monday.com board from which to retrieve items.

tools.name: List Monday boards (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MONDAY_BOARDS instead. Retrieves a list of boards from a Monday.com account, supporting pagination and filtering by state.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination. Increment until an empty response is returned to exhaust results; limit of 50–100 reduces total calls.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of boards to retrieve per page.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: Filters boards by their state. Valid states: 'active', 'archived', 'deleted', or 'all'. Default 'active' excludes archived and deleted boards; use 'all' for a complete board inventory.

tools.name: List columns (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MONDAY_COLUMNS instead. Lists all columns and their properties for a specified Monday.com `board_id`; the board must exist.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board from which to retrieve the columns. Retrieve dynamically; do not hardcode, as board and column IDs are environment-specific.

tools.name: List groups
tools.description: Retrieves groups from a specified Monday.com board, optionally filtering by group IDs. Returns group details such as title, color, position, and archived or deleted status.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board from which to retrieve groups.

inputs.name: group_ids
inputs.about: Optional list of specific group IDs to filter the results; provide to retrieve only these groups. Invalid or non-existent group IDs silently return an empty array rather than an error; always verify the returned groups array is non-empty before indexing.

tools.name: List items
tools.description: Retrieve specified Monday.com items, including subitems, by ID and return their ID, name, and state in raw JSON.

inputs.name: item_ids
inputs.about: Subitem IDs to retrieve. For large sets, batch IDs into smaller requests to avoid response truncation.

tools.name: List items by column values
tools.description: Tool to search for items on a Monday.com board based on column values using the items_page_by_column_values query. Use when you need to find items matching specific column criteria (e.g., status="Done", name contains "Task 1"). For initial requests, provide columns; for pagination, use the cursor from the previous response.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of items to return per page. Default is 25, maximum is 500.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Opaque pagination cursor from previous response. Use instead of columns for paginated requests. When provided, columns parameter is ignored.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.about: Array of column filters to search by. Required for initial request (when cursor is not provided). Uses AND logic between filters and ANY_OF logic within each filter. Cannot be used with cursor.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board's unique identifier. Required for all requests.

tools.name: List subitems by parent
tools.description: Tool to retrieve subitems nested under parent items via GraphQL API. Use when you need to list subitems and their column values for specific parent items. Monday's API requires querying subitems through their parent items.

inputs.name: parent_item_ids
inputs.about: Array of parent item IDs whose subitems should be retrieved. Required.

inputs.name: include_column_values
inputs.about: Whether to include column_values (id, text, value) for each subitem. Defaults to true.

inputs.name: include_parent_fields
inputs.about: Whether to include parent item's id and name in the response. Defaults to true.

tools.name: List team members
tools.description: List members of Monday.com teams, optionally selecting team IDs and filtering or paginating their users.

inputs.name: team_ids
inputs.about: List of team IDs to filter. If omitted, all teams are returned.

inputs.name: user_filters
inputs.about: Filters to apply when querying team users.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users from Monday.com. Paginate by starting at page=1, incrementing page on each request, and stopping when the returned user list is empty. An empty user list does not signify action failure.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for results; starts at 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of users to return per page.

tools.name: Move item to board
tools.description: Moves a Monday.com item to a specified board and group; requires the item, target board, and target group to exist.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item to be moved.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the target board to which the item will be moved.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the target group on the destination board where the item will be placed.

tools.name: Move item to group
tools.description: Moves an item to a different group on the same Monday.com board; the item and group must exist.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item to be moved.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the target group where the item will be moved.

tools.name: Query board mute settings
tools.description: Tool to query a board's notification mute settings. Use when you need to check if notifications are muted for specific boards.

inputs.name: board_ids
inputs.about: The unique identifiers of the boards to retrieve mute settings for. This is a required non-null array of board IDs.

tools.name: Pin update to top
tools.description: Tool to pin an update to the top of an item. Use when you need to highlight an important update or keep it visible at the top.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: update_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the update to pin to the top.

tools.name: Publish object
tools.description: Tool to publish a Monday.com object. Use when you need to make an object publicly visible or change its state to published.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Monday.com object to publish. This is typically a board ID or document ID. The object will be made shareable/public after publishing.

tools.name: Query dashboards
tools.description: Query Monday.com dashboards through the objects API, returning dashboard metadata, owners, and subscribers, with an optional result limit.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of dashboards to return. Limits the result set size.

tools.name: Query sprints
tools.description: Tool to query sprint data for agile project management from Monday.com boards. Use when you need to retrieve sprint information including sprint title, ID, color, position, archived/deleted status, and associated items.

inputs.name: board_ids
inputs.about: List of board IDs to query sprint groups from. Sprints are implemented as groups on sprint boards.

inputs.name: sprint_ids
inputs.about: Optional list of specific sprint (group) IDs to filter the results. If not provided, all sprints on the board will be returned.

tools.name: Remove users from team
tools.description: Removes users from a Monday.com team. Inspect the returned response for successful and failed users and GraphQL errors; these errors do not necessarily cause the tool call to fail.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the existing Monday.com team.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of user IDs to remove from the team.

tools.name: Remove users from workspace
tools.description: Tool to remove users from a workspace. Use when revoking access for specific users in a workspace.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of unique user IDs to remove from the workspace.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the workspace.

tools.name: Set board permission
tools.description: Sets or updates a board's default role and permissions. Use when you need to configure default permissions for a board. Requires boards:write scope and can only be used by board owners on enterprise plans.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board's unique identifier. The board must exist and you must be the board owner.

inputs.name: basic_role_name
inputs.about: The role to assign. 'contributor' allows editing content, 'editor' allows editing content and structure, 'viewer' provides read-only access.

tools.name: Get item timeline
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an item's Email & Activities (E&A) timeline data from Monday.com. Use when you need to access CRM activity tracking and client communication history for a specific item. This returns a paginated list of timeline entries.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item from which to retrieve timeline activities. Must be a valid item ID.

tools.name: Get timeline item
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific timeline item from the Emails & Activities app by ID. Use when you need to fetch metadata including content, user, title, type, and associated custom activity for a timeline item.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the timeline item to retrieve. Must be a valid UUID string obtained from create_timeline_item mutation.

tools.name: Unlike update
tools.description: Tool to remove a like from an update on an item. Use when you want to retract a previously expressed approval or acknowledgment of an update.

inputs.name: update_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the update to unlike.

tools.name: Unpin update from top
tools.description: Tool to unpin an update from the top of an item. Use when you want to remove a pinned update from the top position of an item's updates feed.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the item. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: update_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the update to unpin from the top.

tools.name: Unpublish object
tools.description: Unpublish a Monday.com object (board, item, or workspace) to revert it from a published state. The operation will return success=true only if the object was previously published and can be unpublished. If the object is not in a publishable state or was never published, success=false is returned.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (numeric string) of the Monday.com object to unpublish. This can be a board ID, item ID, or workspace ID. Objects must be in a published state for unpublishing to succeed.

tools.name: Update board
tools.description: Updates a specified attribute of an existing board on Monday.com.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board to be updated.

inputs.name: new_value
inputs.about: The new value to assign to the specified board attribute.

inputs.name: board_attribute
inputs.about: The specific attribute of the board to update. This should be an enum value as defined by Monday.com's API and should not be enclosed in quotes in the final GraphQL mutation. Common updatable attributes include 'description' and 'communication'. Unsupported enum values may be silently ignored withou

tools.name: Update board hierarchy
tools.description: Updates a board's position, workspace, or product in Monday.com. Use when you need to move a board to a different workspace or folder, assign it to a product, or reposition it relative to other boards.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The board's unique identifier.

inputs.name: attributes
inputs.about: The board's attributes to update. At least one attribute (workspace_id, folder_id, account_product_id, or position) must be provided.

tools.name: Update column
tools.description: Tool to update column title or description. Use when modifying a column’s metadata after creation.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new value for the specified column property.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board containing the column to be updated.

inputs.name: column_id
inputs.about: The column's unique identifier (e.g., 'status_1', 'text_2').

inputs.name: column_property
inputs.about: The metadata property to update. Must be 'description' or 'title'.

tools.name: Update a doc
tools.description: Updates a doc's title and/or adds Markdown content, optionally after a specified block. When both are requested, the title is updated first and may remain changed if adding content fails.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The new title for the document.

inputs.name: doc_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Monday.com document to update.

inputs.name: markdown
inputs.about: Markdown content to append to the document.

inputs.name: after_block_id
inputs.about: Block ID after which to insert the markdown content. If omitted, content is appended at the end.

tools.name: Update email domain
tools.description: Tool to update users' email domains. Use when migrating users to a new email domain; requires admin privileges.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of unique identifiers for users whose email domains will be updated.

inputs.name: new_domain
inputs.about: The new email domain to apply to the specified users (e.g., 'newcompany.com').

tools.name: Update a Monday folder
tools.description: Tool to update a Monday.com folder's properties including name, color, or parent folder. Use when you need to modify existing folder details or move folders between workspaces.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the folder.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The folder's color. Available colors include: DONE_GREEN, DARK_RED, LIPSTICK, SALADISH, EGG_YOK, WORKING_ORANGE, DARK_ORANGE, PEACH, SUNSET, STUCK_RED, SOFIA_PINK, PURPLE, DARK_PURPLE, BERRY, ROYAL, BLUISH_PURPLE, NAVY, BRIGHT_BLUE, DARK_BLUE, AQUAMARINE, CHILI_BLUE, RIVER, WINTER, EXPLOSIVE, TESLA,

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the folder to update.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workspace to move the folder to. Use for cross-workspace transfers.

inputs.name: parent_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the folder you want to nest the updated folder under. Use to move folder to a different parent.

tools.name: Update group
tools.description: Tool to update an existing group on a board. Use when you need to modify a group's attribute (title, color, or position) after confirming the group ID.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board containing the group.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the group to update (use the group ID or descriptive string).

inputs.name: new_value
inputs.about: The new value for the specified attribute. For title or color, provide the new string value. For relative_position_after/before, provide the target group ID.

inputs.name: group_attribute
inputs.about: The attribute of the group to update. Must be one of: color, position, relative_position_after, relative_position_before, title. Do not enclose this enum value in quotes in the GraphQL mutation.

tools.name: Update item
tools.description: Tool to update an existing item's column value on Monday.com. Use when setting complex column types like Timeline or People.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: New column value as a JSON-serializable object or string. This will be stringified for the GraphQL mutation. For text/number/name columns, send a plain string; for complex columns like status/timeline/people, send a JSON object (e.g., {"index": 1}).

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: ID of the item to update.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: ID of the board containing the item.

inputs.name: column_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the column to change.

inputs.name: create_labels_if_missing
inputs.about: If true, creates missing labels for Status/Dropdown columns when the label does not exist. Requires permission to change board structure.

tools.name: Update multiple users
tools.description: Tool to update one or multiple users' attributes on Monday.com. Use when you need to batch update user profiles such as name, email, title, or department.

inputs.name: user_updates
inputs.about: Array of user update objects, each containing user_id and the attributes to update. At least one user update must be provided.

tools.name: Update mute board settings
tools.description: Tool to update a board's notification mute settings. Use when you need to configure notification preferences for a specific board.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.about: Array of custom notification settings, only applicable when mute_state is CUSTOM_SETTINGS. AUTOMATION_NOTIFY: alerts when automations trigger notify steps. IM_ASSIGNED: alerts when user is assigned. IM_MENTIONED: alerts when user is mentioned.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board to modify.

inputs.name: mute_state
inputs.about: Desired mute notification state. CURRENT_USER_MUTE_ALL: suppress all notifications for current user. CUSTOM_SETTINGS: allow notifications matching enabled custom settings. MENTIONS_AND_ASSIGNS_ONLY: notify only for mentions or assignments. MUTE_ALL: suppress notifications for all users (admin only).

tools.name: Update tag
tools.description: Tool to return a tag's details or best-effort "rename" by creating or getting a tag with the requested name. The monday API does not support updating existing tag name/color.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the tag. monday API does not support renaming a tag; we will create or get a tag with this name and return it.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: New color for the tag as a hex code (e.g., '#FFAA00'). monday API does not support changing tag colors; this parameter is ignored.

inputs.name: tag_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the tag to update or fetch.

tools.name: Update team
tools.description: Add users to a Monday.com team. Name, guest status, and parent team changes are ignored; the response includes warnings and the raw result of the add-users operation, including any GraphQL errors.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the team.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the team to be updated.

inputs.name: is_guest_team
inputs.about: Whether the team should be marked as a guest team.

inputs.name: parent_team_id
inputs.about: ID of the new parent team if changing hierarchy.

inputs.name: subscriber_ids
inputs.about: List of user IDs to subscribe to the team.

tools.name: Update users role
tools.description: Updates users' roles to custom or default roles; this admin-only operation cannot update your own role. Inspect the returned updated users and per-user errors to determine which changes succeeded.

inputs.name: role_id
inputs.about: Custom role ID to assign (for enterprise customers only). Either new_role or role_id must be provided.

inputs.name: new_role
inputs.about: Default role to assign. Use this for standard roles. Valid values: ADMIN, GUEST, MEMBER, VIEW_ONLY. Either new_role or role_id must be provided.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: List of unique identifiers for users whose roles will be updated. Maximum 200 user IDs per request.

tools.name: Update a Monday workspace
tools.description: Tool to update a Monday.com workspace. Use when you need to modify the name, description, visibility, or product placement of an existing workspace.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: The visibility kind for the workspace; 'open' or 'closed'.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the workspace.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The new description for the workspace.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the workspace to be updated.

inputs.name: account_product_id
inputs.about: The account product ID to move the workspace under (API v2025-10+).

tools.name: Upload Asset
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to an update or file column. Use when you need to attach a file to an existing update or file column. File attachments are permanent and irreversible; confirm with the user before uploading.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: File to upload.

inputs.name: target
inputs.about: Where to upload the file. Use 'update' to attach the file to an existing update/comment, or 'column' to upload to a file column on an item.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the item containing the file column. Required when target is 'column'. You can get this ID from creating an item or listing board items.

inputs.name: column_id
inputs.about: The ID of the file column to upload to. Required when target is 'column'. File columns have type 'file' and can be found by listing board columns.

inputs.name: update_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the update (comment) to attach the file to. Required when target is 'update'. You can get this ID from creating an update or listing updates on an item.

tools.name: Get user connections
tools.description: Tool to query user-specific connection data from Monday.com. Use when you need to retrieve integration connections established by the authenticated user with external services.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page index for offset-based pagination, starting from 1. Use with page_size for paginated results.

inputs.name: order
inputs.about: Ordering of returned connections. Use 'createdAt' for ascending or '-createdAt' for descending order by creation date.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page when using offset-based pagination. Use with page parameter.

inputs.name: with_automations
inputs.about: Include connections that have automations attached. Set to true to filter only connections with automations.

inputs.name: with_state_validation
inputs.about: Validate connection state before returning the result. Set to true to ensure connections are in valid state.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (name, email, account) of the connected monday.com account.
